    o4.xyz = EmissiveColor.xyz;                                                           // 157  mov o4.xyz, cb2[1].xyzx

}

    r1.xyz = gl_TessCoord.xxx * tcs_TANGENT0[0].xyz + r1.xyz;                             // 90  mad r1.xyz, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][3].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xyz = gl_TessCoord.zzz * tcs_TANGENT0[2].xyz + r1.xyz;                             // 91  mad r1.xyz, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][3].xyzx, r1.xyzx
                                                                                          // 92  dp3 o3.x, cb12[8].xyzx, r1.xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
    r2.xyz = gl_TessCoord.yyy * tcs_BINORMAL0[1].xyz;                                     // 93  mul r2.xyz, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][2].xyzx
    r2.xyz = gl_TessCoord.xxx * tcs_BINORMAL0[0].xyz + r2.xyz;                            // 94  mad r2.xyz, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][2].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    r2.xyz = gl_TessCoord.zzz * tcs_BINORMAL0[2].xyz + r2.xyz;                            // 95  mad r2.xyz, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][2].xyzx, r2.xyzx
                                                                                          // 96  dp3 o3.y, cb12[8].xyzx, r2.xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 97  dp3 o4.x, cb12[9].xyzx, r1.xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
    o5.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 98  dp3 o5.x, cb12[10].xyzx, r1.xyzx
                                                                                          // 99  dp3 o4.y, cb12[9].xyzx, r2.xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
    o5.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 100  dp3 o5.y, cb12[10].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o4.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r0.yzw);                                             // 101  dp3 o4.z, cb12[9].xyzx, r0.yzwy
    o5.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r0.yzw);                                             // 102  dp3 o5.z, cb12[10].xyzx, r0.yzwy
                                                                                          // 103  mul r0.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][6].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 104  mad r0.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][6].xyzw, r0.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 105  mad o6.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][6].xyzw, r0.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 106  mul r0.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 107  mad r0.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r0.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 108  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r0.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    return;                                                                               // 109  ret
}

void Fo4GDs_rec2560(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out vec4 o2, out vec4 o3, out vec4 o4, out vec4 o5, out vec4 o6, out vec4 o7)

    r0.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_POSITION0[0].xyzw + r0.xyzw;                        // 75  mad r0.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][0].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret

    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.xx * tcs_TEXCOORD0[0].xy + r1.xy;                                // 100  mad r1.xy, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    o1.xy = gl_TessCoord.zz * tcs_TEXCOORD0[2].xy + r1.xy;                                // 101  mad o1.xy, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD8[1].x;                                           // 102  mul r1.x, vDomain.y, vicp[1][6].x
    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD8[0].x + r1.x;                                    // 103  mad r1.x, vDomain.x, vicp[0][6].x, r1.x
    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD8[2].x + r1.x;                                    // 104  mad r1.x, vDomain.z, vicp[2][6].x, r1.x
    b1.z = (0.0 != tcs_pc_PSIZE0.y);                                                      // 105  ne r1.z, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), vpc0.y
    if (b1.z) {                                                                           // 106  if_nz r1.z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD7[1].z;                                       // 107  mul r1.z, vDomain.y, vicp[1][4].z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD7[0].z + r1.z;                                // 108  mad r1.z, vDomain.x, vicp[0][4].z, r1.z
        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 109  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 110  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)
        if (b1.z) {                                                                       // 111  if_nz r1.z
            r2.xyz = r0.xyz + -DismemberAdjustedHitLoc.xyz;                               // 112  add r2.xyz, r0.xyzx, -cb2[5].xyzx

            r3.xyz = -r1.zzz * DismemberNormal.xyz + r0.xyz;                              // 114  mad r3.xyz, -r1.zzzz, cb2[2].xyzx, r0.xyzx

            r4.y = dot(DismemberBinormal.xyz, r2.xyz);                                    // 116  dp3 r4.y, cb2[3].xyzx, r2.xyzx
            r1.zw = vec2(d3d_div(r4.x, DismemberHitLoc.w), d3d_div(r4.y, DismemberHitLoc.w));// 117  div r1.zw, r4.xxxy, cb2[0].wwww

            r2.x = textureLod(t7, r1.zw, 0.0).x;                                          // 119  sample_l_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r2.x, r1.zwzz, t7.xyzw, s7, l(0.000000)
            r2.x = r2.x * 2.0 + -1.0;                                                     // 120  mad r2.x, r2.x, l(2.000000), l(-1.000000)
            r2.y = d3d_sat(r1.y * 4.0);                                                   // 121  mul_sat r2.y, r1.y, l(4.000000)
            r2.z = r2.y * -2.0 + 3.0;                                                     // 122  mad r2.z, r2.y, l(-2.000000), l(3.000000)
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.y;                                                           // 123  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.y
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 124  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z
            r2.y = r2.y * DismemberNormal.w;                                              // 125  mul r2.y, r2.y, cb2[2].w
            r2.x = r2.y * r2.x;                                                           // 126  mul r2.x, r2.y, r2.x

            r0.xyz = DismemberNormal.xyz * r1.xxx + r3.xyz;                               // 128  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r1.xxxx, r3.xyzx
        } else {                                                                          // 129  else
            i1.yzw = ivec3(0, 0, 0);                                                      // 130  mov r1.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
        }                                                                                 // 131  endif
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 132  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o6.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 133  mov o6.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 134  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 135  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 136  mov o6.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o6.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 137  mov o6.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 138  endif
                                                                                          // 139  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 141  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 142  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][8].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 143  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.yyyy * tcs_COLOR0[1].xyzw;                                     // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_COLOR0[0].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o2.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.zzzz * tcs_COLOR0[2].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 147  mad o2.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 148  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 149  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 150  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 151  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 152  ret
}

    } else {                                                                              // 134  else
                                                                                          // 135  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mov o6.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 137  mov o6.y, l(0)   [no consumer: omitted]
    }                                                                                     // 138  endif
                                                                                          // 139  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 141  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 142  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][8].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 143  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 147  mad o2.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 148  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 149  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 150  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 151  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 152  ret
}

void Fo4GDs_rec2565(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out vec4 o2, out vec4 o3, out vec4 o4, out vec4 o5, out vec4 o6, out vec4 o7)

    r0.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.yyyy * tcs_POSITION0[1].xyzw;                                  // 74  mul r0.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][0].xyzw
    r0.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_POSITION0[0].xyzw + r0.xyzw;                        // 75  mad r0.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][0].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    r0.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.zzzz * tcs_POSITION0[2].xyzw + r0.xyzw;                        // 76  mad r0.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][0].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    r1.xyz = gl_TessCoord.xxx * tcs_NORMAL0[0].xyz + r1.xyz;                              // 78  mad r1.xyz, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][1].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xyz = gl_TessCoord.zzz * tcs_NORMAL0[2].xyz + r1.xyz;                              // 79  mad r1.xyz, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][1].xyzx, r1.xyzx

    r2.xyz = gl_TessCoord.xxx * tcs_BINORMAL0[0].xyz + r2.xyz;                            // 81  mad r2.xyz, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][2].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    r2.xyz = gl_TessCoord.zzz * tcs_BINORMAL0[2].xyz + r2.xyz;                            // 82  mad r2.xyz, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][2].xyzx, r2.xyzx

    o3.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 90  dp3 o3.y, cb12[9].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o3.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 91  dp3 o3.z, cb12[9].xyzx, r1.xyzx

    o4.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 93  dp3 o4.y, cb12[10].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o4.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 94  dp3 o4.z, cb12[10].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.yy * tcs_TEXCOORD0[1].xy;                                        // 95  mul r1.xy, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][4].xyxx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.xx * tcs_TEXCOORD0[0].xy + r1.xy;                                // 96  mad r1.xy, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    o1.xy = gl_TessCoord.zz * tcs_TEXCOORD0[2].xy + r1.xy;                                // 97  mad o1.xy, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx

    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD8[2].x + r1.x;                                    // 100  mad r1.x, vDomain.z, vicp[2][5].x, r1.x
    b1.z = (0.0 != tcs_pc_PSIZE0.y);                                                      // 101  ne r1.z, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), vpc0.y
    if (b1.z) {                                                                           // 102  if_nz r1.z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD7[1].z;                                       // 103  mul r1.z, vDomain.y, vicp[1][4].z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD7[0].z + r1.z;                                // 104  mad r1.z, vDomain.x, vicp[0][4].z, r1.z
        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 105  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 106  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)
        if (b1.z) {                                                                       // 107  if_nz r1.z
            r2.xyz = r0.xyz + -DismemberAdjustedHitLoc.xyz;                               // 108  add r2.xyz, r0.xyzx, -cb2[5].xyzx
            r1.z = dot(r2.xyz, DismemberNormal.xyz);                                      // 109  dp3 r1.z, r2.xyzx, cb2[2].xyzx
            r3.xyz = -r1.zzz * DismemberNormal.xyz + r0.xyz;                              // 110  mad r3.xyz, -r1.zzzz, cb2[2].xyzx, r0.xyzx

            r4.y = dot(DismemberBinormal.xyz, r2.xyz);                                    // 112  dp3 r4.y, cb2[3].xyzx, r2.xyzx

            r1.zw = r1.zw * vec2(0.5, 0.5) + vec2(0.5, 0.5);                              // 114  mad r1.zw, r1.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000)
            r2.x = textureLod(t7, r1.zw, 0.0).x;                                          // 115  sample_l_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r2.x, r1.zwzz, t7.xyzw, s7, l(0.000000)
            r2.x = r2.x * 2.0 + -1.0;                                                     // 116  mad r2.x, r2.x, l(2.000000), l(-1.000000)
            r2.y = d3d_sat(r1.y * 4.0);                                                   // 117  mul_sat r2.y, r1.y, l(4.000000)
            r2.z = r2.y * -2.0 + 3.0;                                                     // 118  mad r2.z, r2.y, l(-2.000000), l(3.000000)
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.y;                                                           // 119  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.y
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 120  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z

        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 131  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 132  mov o5.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o5.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 133  mov o5.y, l(0)

    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
}

    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD8[2].x + r1.x;                                    // 104  mad r1.x, vDomain.z, vicp[2][6].x, r1.x
    b1.z = (0.0 != tcs_pc_PSIZE0.y);                                                      // 105  ne r1.z, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), vpc0.y
    if (b1.z) {                                                                           // 106  if_nz r1.z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD7[1].z;                                       // 107  mul r1.z, vDomain.y, vicp[1][4].z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD7[0].z + r1.z;                                // 108  mad r1.z, vDomain.x, vicp[0][4].z, r1.z
        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 109  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 110  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)
        if (b1.z) {                                                                       // 111  if_nz r1.z
            r2.xyz = r0.xyz + -DismemberAdjustedHitLoc.xyz;                               // 112  add r2.xyz, r0.xyzx, -cb2[5].xyzx
            r1.z = dot(r2.xyz, DismemberNormal.xyz);                                      // 113  dp3 r1.z, r2.xyzx, cb2[2].xyzx

            r2.x = textureLod(t7, r1.zw, 0.0).x;                                          // 119  sample_l_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r2.x, r1.zwzz, t7.xyzw, s7, l(0.000000)
            r2.x = r2.x * 2.0 + -1.0;                                                     // 120  mad r2.x, r2.x, l(2.000000), l(-1.000000)
            r2.y = d3d_sat(r1.y * 4.0);                                                   // 121  mul_sat r2.y, r1.y, l(4.000000)
            r2.z = r2.y * -2.0 + 3.0;                                                     // 122  mad r2.z, r2.y, l(-2.000000), l(3.000000)
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.y;                                                           // 123  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.y
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 124  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z
            r2.y = r2.y * DismemberNormal.w;                                              // 125  mul r2.y, r2.y, cb2[2].w
            r2.x = r2.y * r2.x;                                                           // 126  mul r2.x, r2.y, r2.x

            r0.xyz = DismemberNormal.xyz * r1.xxx + r3.xyz;                               // 128  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r1.xxxx, r3.xyzx
        } else {                                                                          // 129  else
            i1.yzw = ivec3(0, 0, 0);                                                      // 130  mov r1.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
        }                                                                                 // 131  endif
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 132  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o6.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 133  mov o6.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 134  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 135  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 136  mov o6.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o6.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 137  mov o6.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 138  endif
                                                                                          // 139  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 141  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 142  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][8].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 143  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.yyyy * tcs_COLOR0[1].xyzw;                                     // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_COLOR0[0].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o2.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.zzzz * tcs_COLOR0[2].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 147  mad o2.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 148  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 149  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 150  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 151  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 152  ret
}

}

                                                                                          // 140  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 141  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 142  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][8].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 143  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.yyyy * tcs_COLOR0[1].xyzw;                                     // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_COLOR0[0].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o2.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.zzzz * tcs_COLOR0[2].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 147  mad o2.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 148  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 149  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 150  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 151  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 152  ret
}

    r0.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.yyyy * tcs_POSITION0[1].xyzw;                                  // 74  mul r0.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][0].xyzw
    r0.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_POSITION0[0].xyzw + r0.xyzw;                        // 75  mad r0.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][0].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    r0.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.zzzz * tcs_POSITION0[2].xyzw + r0.xyzw;                        // 76  mad r0.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][0].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    r1.xyz = gl_TessCoord.zzz * tcs_NORMAL0[2].xyz + r1.xyz;                              // 79  mad r1.xyz, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][1].xyzx, r1.xyzx

    o3.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 90  dp3 o3.y, cb12[9].xyzx, r2.xyzx

    o4.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 94  dp3 o4.z, cb12[10].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.yy * tcs_TEXCOORD0[1].xy;                                        // 95  mul r1.xy, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][4].xyxx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.xx * tcs_TEXCOORD0[0].xy + r1.xy;                                // 96  mad r1.xy, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    o1.xy = gl_TessCoord.zz * tcs_TEXCOORD0[2].xy + r1.xy;                                // 97  mad o1.xy, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx

    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD8[2].x + r1.x;                                    // 100  mad r1.x, vDomain.z, vicp[2][5].x, r1.x

        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 105  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 106  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)

            r1.z = dot(r2.xyz, DismemberNormal.xyz);                                      // 109  dp3 r1.z, r2.xyzx, cb2[2].xyzx

            r1.zw = r1.zw * vec2(0.5, 0.5) + vec2(0.5, 0.5);                              // 114  mad r1.zw, r1.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000)
            r2.x = textureLod(t7, r1.zw, 0.0).x;                                          // 115  sample_l_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r2.x, r1.zwzz, t7.xyzw, s7, l(0.000000)

    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret

    b1.z = (0.0 != tcs_pc_PSIZE0.y);                                                      // 105  ne r1.z, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), vpc0.y
    if (b1.z) {                                                                           // 106  if_nz r1.z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD7[1].z;                                       // 107  mul r1.z, vDomain.y, vicp[1][4].z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD7[0].z + r1.z;                                // 108  mad r1.z, vDomain.x, vicp[0][4].z, r1.z
        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 109  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 110  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)

            r2.xyz = r0.xyz + -DismemberAdjustedHitLoc.xyz;                               // 112  add r2.xyz, r0.xyzx, -cb2[5].xyzx

            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 124  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z

            r2.x = r2.y * r2.x;                                                           // 126  mul r2.x, r2.y, r2.x

        } else {                                                                          // 129  else
            i1.yzw = ivec3(0, 0, 0);                                                      // 130  mov r1.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
        }                                                                                 // 131  endif
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 132  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o6.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 133  mov o6.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 134  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 135  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 136  mov o6.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o6.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 137  mov o6.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 138  endif
                                                                                          // 139  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 141  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 142  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][8].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 143  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.yyyy * tcs_COLOR0[1].xyzw;                                     // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_COLOR0[0].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o2.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.zzzz * tcs_COLOR0[2].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 147  mad o2.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 148  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 149  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 150  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 151  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 152  ret
}

                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 147  mad o2.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 148  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 149  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 150  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 151  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 152  ret
}

            r1.zw = r1.zw * vec2(0.5, 0.5) + vec2(0.5, 0.5);                              // 114  mad r1.zw, r1.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000)

            r2.x = r2.x * 2.0 + -1.0;                                                     // 116  mad r2.x, r2.x, l(2.000000), l(-1.000000)
            r2.y = d3d_sat(r1.y * 4.0);                                                   // 117  mul_sat r2.y, r1.y, l(4.000000)
            r2.z = r2.y * -2.0 + 3.0;                                                     // 118  mad r2.z, r2.y, l(-2.000000), l(3.000000)
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.y;                                                           // 119  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.y
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 120  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z
            r2.y = r2.y * DismemberNormal.w;                                              // 121  mul r2.y, r2.y, cb2[2].w
            r2.x = r2.y * r2.x;                                                           // 122  mul r2.x, r2.y, r2.x
            r1.x = -r2.x;                                                                 // 123  mov r1.x, -r2.x
            r0.xyz = DismemberNormal.xyz * r1.xxx + r3.xyz;                               // 124  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r1.xxxx, r3.xyzx
        } else {                                                                          // 125  else
            i1.yzw = ivec3(0, 0, 0);                                                      // 126  mov r1.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
        }                                                                                 // 127  endif
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 128  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o5.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 129  mov o5.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 130  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 131  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 132  mov o5.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o5.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 133  mov o5.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 134  endif
                                                                                          // 135  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][6].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 137  mad o6.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 138  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 139  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 141  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
}

    o4.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 93  dp3 o4.y, cb12[10].xyzx, r2.xyzx

    } else {                                                                              // 130  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 131  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 132  mov o5.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]

                                                                                          // 135  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][6].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]

    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 141  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
}

            r2.z = r2.y * -2.0 + 3.0;                                                     // 118  mad r2.z, r2.y, l(-2.000000), l(3.000000)
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.y;                                                           // 119  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.y
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 120  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z
            r2.y = r2.y * DismemberNormal.w;                                              // 121  mul r2.y, r2.y, cb2[2].w
            r2.x = r2.y * r2.x;                                                           // 122  mul r2.x, r2.y, r2.x
            r1.x = -r2.x;                                                                 // 123  mov r1.x, -r2.x
            r0.xyz = DismemberNormal.xyz * r1.xxx + r3.xyz;                               // 124  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r1.xxxx, r3.xyzx
        } else {                                                                          // 125  else
            i1.yzw = ivec3(0, 0, 0);                                                      // 126  mov r1.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
        }                                                                                 // 127  endif
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 128  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o5.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 129  mov o5.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 130  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 131  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 132  mov o5.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o5.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 133  mov o5.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 134  endif
                                                                                          // 135  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][6].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 137  mad o6.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 138  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 139  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 141  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 142  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
}

    o3.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r3.xyz);                                             // 89  dp3 o3.x, cb12[9].xyzx, r3.xyzx
    o3.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 90  dp3 o3.y, cb12[9].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o3.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 91  dp3 o3.z, cb12[9].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    o4.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r3.xyz);                                             // 92  dp3 o4.x, cb12[10].xyzx, r3.xyzx
    o4.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 93  dp3 o4.y, cb12[10].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o4.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 94  dp3 o4.z, cb12[10].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.yy * tcs_TEXCOORD0[1].xy;                                        // 95  mul r1.xy, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][4].xyxx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.xx * tcs_TEXCOORD0[0].xy + r1.xy;                                // 96  mad r1.xy, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    o1.xy = gl_TessCoord.zz * tcs_TEXCOORD0[2].xy + r1.xy;                                // 97  mad o1.xy, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD8[1].x;                                           // 98  mul r1.x, vDomain.y, vicp[1][5].x
    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD8[0].x + r1.x;                                    // 99  mad r1.x, vDomain.x, vicp[0][5].x, r1.x
    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD8[2].x + r1.x;                                    // 100  mad r1.x, vDomain.z, vicp[2][5].x, r1.x
    b1.z = (0.0 != tcs_pc_PSIZE0.y);                                                      // 101  ne r1.z, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), vpc0.y
    if (b1.z) {                                                                           // 102  if_nz r1.z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD7[1].z;                                       // 103  mul r1.z, vDomain.y, vicp[1][4].z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD7[0].z + r1.z;                                // 104  mad r1.z, vDomain.x, vicp[0][4].z, r1.z
        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 105  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 106  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)
        if (b1.z) {                                                                       // 107  if_nz r1.z
            r2.xyz = r0.xyz + -DismemberAdjustedHitLoc.xyz;                               // 108  add r2.xyz, r0.xyzx, -cb2[5].xyzx
            r1.z = dot(r2.xyz, DismemberNormal.xyz);                                      // 109  dp3 r1.z, r2.xyzx, cb2[2].xyzx
            r3.xyz = -r1.zzz * DismemberNormal.xyz + r0.xyz;                              // 110  mad r3.xyz, -r1.zzzz, cb2[2].xyzx, r0.xyzx
            r4.x = dot(DismemberTangent.xyz, r2.xyz);                                     // 111  dp3 r4.x, cb2[4].xyzx, r2.xyzx
            r4.y = dot(DismemberBinormal.xyz, r2.xyz);                                    // 112  dp3 r4.y, cb2[3].xyzx, r2.xyzx
            r1.zw = vec2(d3d_div(r4.x, DismemberHitLoc.w), d3d_div(r4.y, DismemberHitLoc.w));// 113  div r1.zw, r4.xxxy, cb2[0].wwww
            r1.zw = r1.zw * vec2(0.5, 0.5) + vec2(0.5, 0.5);                              // 114  mad r1.zw, r1.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000)
            r2.x = textureLod(t7, r1.zw, 0.0).x;                                          // 115  sample_l_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r2.x, r1.zwzz, t7.xyzw, s7, l(0.000000)
            r2.x = r2.x * 2.0 + -1.0;                                                     // 116  mad r2.x, r2.x, l(2.000000), l(-1.000000)
            r2.y = d3d_sat(r1.y * 4.0);                                                   // 117  mul_sat r2.y, r1.y, l(4.000000)
            r2.z = r2.y * -2.0 + 3.0;                                                     // 118  mad r2.z, r2.y, l(-2.000000), l(3.000000)
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.y;                                                           // 119  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.y
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 120  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z
            r2.y = r2.y * DismemberNormal.w;                                              // 121  mul r2.y, r2.y, cb2[2].w
            r2.x = r2.y * r2.x;                                                           // 122  mul r2.x, r2.y, r2.x
            r1.x = -r2.x;                                                                 // 123  mov r1.x, -r2.x
            r0.xyz = DismemberNormal.xyz * r1.xxx + r3.xyz;                               // 124  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r1.xxxx, r3.xyzx
        } else {                                                                          // 125  else
            i1.yzw = ivec3(0, 0, 0);                                                      // 126  mov r1.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
        }                                                                                 // 127  endif
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 128  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o5.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 129  mov o5.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 130  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 131  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 132  mov o5.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o5.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 133  mov o5.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 134  endif
                                                                                          // 135  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][6].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 137  mad o6.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 138  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 139  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 141  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 142  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
}

            r2.z = r2.y * -2.0 + 3.0;                                                     // 118  mad r2.z, r2.y, l(-2.000000), l(3.000000)
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.y;                                                           // 119  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.y
            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 120  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z
            r2.y = r2.y * DismemberNormal.w;                                              // 121  mul r2.y, r2.y, cb2[2].w
            r2.x = r2.y * r2.x;                                                           // 122  mul r2.x, r2.y, r2.x
            r1.x = -r2.x;                                                                 // 123  mov r1.x, -r2.x
            r0.xyz = DismemberNormal.xyz * r1.xxx + r3.xyz;                               // 124  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r1.xxxx, r3.xyzx
        } else {                                                                          // 125  else
            i1.yzw = ivec3(0, 0, 0);                                                      // 126  mov r1.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
        }                                                                                 // 127  endif
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 128  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o5.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 129  mov o5.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 130  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 131  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 132  mov o5.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o5.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 133  mov o5.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 134  endif
                                                                                          // 135  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][6].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 137  mad o6.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 138  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 139  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 141  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
}

    o2.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 88  dp3 o2.z, cb12[8].xyzx, r1.xyzx

    o3.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 91  dp3 o3.z, cb12[9].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    o4.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r3.xyz);                                             // 92  dp3 o4.x, cb12[10].xyzx, r3.xyzx
    o4.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 93  dp3 o4.y, cb12[10].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o4.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 94  dp3 o4.z, cb12[10].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.yy * tcs_TEXCOORD0[1].xy;                                        // 95  mul r1.xy, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][4].xyxx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.xx * tcs_TEXCOORD0[0].xy + r1.xy;                                // 96  mad r1.xy, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    o1.xy = gl_TessCoord.zz * tcs_TEXCOORD0[2].xy + r1.xy;                                // 97  mad o1.xy, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx

    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD8[0].x + r1.x;                                    // 99  mad r1.x, vDomain.x, vicp[0][5].x, r1.x
    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD8[2].x + r1.x;                                    // 100  mad r1.x, vDomain.z, vicp[2][5].x, r1.x
    b1.z = (0.0 != tcs_pc_PSIZE0.y);                                                      // 101  ne r1.z, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), vpc0.y

        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD7[1].z;                                       // 103  mul r1.z, vDomain.y, vicp[1][4].z

            r2.y = r2.y * r2.z;                                                           // 120  mul r2.y, r2.y, r2.z
            r2.y = r2.y * DismemberNormal.w;                                              // 121  mul r2.y, r2.y, cb2[2].w
            r2.x = r2.y * r2.x;                                                           // 122  mul r2.x, r2.y, r2.x

        }                                                                                 // 127  endif
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 128  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o5.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 129  mov o5.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 130  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 131  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 132  mov o5.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o5.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 133  mov o5.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 134  endif
                                                                                          // 135  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][6].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 137  mad o6.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]

                                                                                          // 139  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]

    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 141  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
}

            r1.x = -r2.x;                                                                 // 127  mov r1.x, -r2.x
            r0.xyz = DismemberNormal.xyz * r1.xxx + r3.xyz;                               // 128  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r1.xxxx, r3.xyzx
        } else {                                                                          // 129  else
                                                                                          // 130  mov r1.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)   [no consumer: omitted]
        }                                                                                 // 131  endif
                                                                                          // 132  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 133  mov o6.xy, r1.xyxx   [no consumer: omitted]
    } else {                                                                              // 134  else
                                                                                          // 135  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mov o6.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 137  mov o6.y, l(0)   [no consumer: omitted]
    }                                                                                     // 138  endif
                                                                                          // 139  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 141  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 142  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][8].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 143  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 147  mad o2.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 148  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 149  dp4 o0.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 150  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 151  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 152  ret
}

                                                                                          // 122  dp4 o7.w, cb2[7].xyzw, r2.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    return;                                                                               // 123  ret
}

// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec2590, loader 0x14181E030, obj+0x68; names 0x142273200): DismemberHitLoc = cb2[0].x, DismemberNormal = cb2[2].x, DismemberBinormal = cb2[3].x, DismemberTangent = cb2[4].x, DismemberAdjustedHitLoc = cb2[5].x
void Fo4GDs_rec2590(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out vec4 o2, out vec4 o3, out vec4 o4, out vec4 o5, out vec4 o6, out vec4 o7)

    r0.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.zzzz * tcs_POSITION0[2].xyzw + r0.xyzw;                        // 76  mad r0.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][0].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    r1.xyz = gl_TessCoord.xxx * tcs_NORMAL0[0].xyz + r1.xyz;                              // 78  mad r1.xyz, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][1].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xyz = gl_TessCoord.zzz * tcs_NORMAL0[2].xyz + r1.xyz;                              // 79  mad r1.xyz, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][1].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r2.xyz = gl_TessCoord.yyy * tcs_BINORMAL0[1].xyz;                                     // 80  mul r2.xyz, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][2].xyzx

    o2.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyz, r3.xyz);                                             // 86  dp3 o2.x, cb12[8].xyzx, r3.xyzx
    o2.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 87  dp3 o2.y, cb12[8].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o2.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 88  dp3 o2.z, cb12[8].xyzx, r1.xyzx

    o3.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 90  dp3 o3.y, cb12[9].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o3.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 91  dp3 o3.z, cb12[9].xyzx, r1.xyzx

    o4.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 94  dp3 o4.z, cb12[10].xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.yy * tcs_TEXCOORD0[1].xy;                                        // 95  mul r1.xy, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][4].xyxx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.xx * tcs_TEXCOORD0[0].xy + r1.xy;                                // 96  mad r1.xy, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    o1.xy = gl_TessCoord.zz * tcs_TEXCOORD0[2].xy + r1.xy;                                // 97  mad o1.xy, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx

    r1.x = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD8[2].x + r1.x;                                    // 100  mad r1.x, vDomain.z, vicp[2][5].x, r1.x
    b1.z = (0.0 != tcs_pc_PSIZE0.y);                                                      // 101  ne r1.z, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), vpc0.y
    if (b1.z) {                                                                           // 102  if_nz r1.z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD7[1].z;                                       // 103  mul r1.z, vDomain.y, vicp[1][4].z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD7[0].z + r1.z;                                // 104  mad r1.z, vDomain.x, vicp[0][4].z, r1.z
        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 105  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 106  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)
        if (b1.z) {                                                                       // 107  if_nz r1.z
            r2.xyz = r0.xyz + -DismemberAdjustedHitLoc.xyz;                               // 108  add r2.xyz, r0.xyzx, -cb2[5].xyzx
            r1.z = dot(r2.xyz, DismemberNormal.xyz);                                      // 109  dp3 r1.z, r2.xyzx, cb2[2].xyzx
            r3.xyz = -r1.zzz * DismemberNormal.xyz + r0.xyz;                              // 110  mad r3.xyz, -r1.zzzz, cb2[2].xyzx, r0.xyzx

            r4.y = dot(DismemberBinormal.xyz, r2.xyz);                                    // 112  dp3 r4.y, cb2[3].xyzx, r2.xyzx

            r1.zw = r1.zw * vec2(0.5, 0.5) + vec2(0.5, 0.5);                              // 114  mad r1.zw, r1.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000)
            r2.x = textureLod(t7, r1.zw, 0.0).x;                                          // 115  sample_l_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r2.x, r1.zwzz, t7.xyzw, s7, l(0.000000)

        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 131  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 132  mov o5.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o5.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 133  mov o5.y, l(0)

                                                                                          // 135  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][6].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 136  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][6].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]

    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 141  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 143  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
}

    } else {                                                                              // 134  else

                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.yyyy * tcs_COLOR0[1].xyzw;                                     // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_COLOR0[0].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw

    o0.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 150  dp4 o0.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 151  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    r3.xyz = gl_TessCoord.zzz * tcs_TANGENT0[2].xyz + r3.xyz;                             // 89  mad r3.xyz, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][3].xyzx, r3.xyzx

    o5.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r2.xyz);                                             // 97  dp3 o5.y, cb12[10].xyzx, r2.xyzx
    o5.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r1.xyz);                                             // 98  dp3 o5.z, cb12[10].xyzx, r1.xyzx

        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.y * tcs_TEXCOORD7[1].z;                                       // 107  mul r1.z, vDomain.y, vicp[1][4].z
        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD7[0].z + r1.z;                                // 108  mad r1.z, vDomain.x, vicp[0][4].z, r1.z
        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 109  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 110  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)
        if (b1.z) {                                                                       // 111  if_nz r1.z

            r2.x = r2.x * 2.0 + -1.0;                                                     // 120  mad r2.x, r2.x, l(2.000000), l(-1.000000)
            r2.y = d3d_sat(r1.y * 4.0);                                                   // 121  mul_sat r2.y, r1.y, l(4.000000)

        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(i1.z, i1.w));                                        // 132  mov o1.zw, r1.zzzw
        o6.xy = vec2(r1.x, intBitsToFloat(i1.y));                                         // 133  mov o6.xy, r1.xyxx
    } else {                                                                              // 134  else
        o1.zw = intBitsToFloat(ivec2(0, 0));                                              // 135  mov o1.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
                                                                                          // 136  mov o6.x, r1.x   [no consumer: omitted]
        o6.y = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                         // 137  mov o6.y, l(0)
    }                                                                                     // 138  endif
                                                                                          // 139  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][7].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 140  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 141  mad o7.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][7].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 142  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][8].xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 143  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 144  mad o8.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][8].xyzw, r1.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.yyyy * tcs_COLOR0[1].xyzw;                                     // 145  mul r1.xyzw, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][5].xyzw
    r1.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.xxxx * tcs_COLOR0[0].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 146  mad r1.xyzw, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o2.xyzw = gl_TessCoord.zzzz * tcs_COLOR0[2].xyzw + r1.xyzw;                           // 147  mad o2.xyzw, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][5].xyzw, r1.xyzw
    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 148  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    o4.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r3.xyz);                                             // 109  dp3 o4.y, cb12[9].xyzx, r3.xyzx
    o5.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r3.xyz);                                             // 110  dp3 o5.y, cb12[10].xyzx, r3.xyzx
    o4.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyz, r1.yzw);                                             // 111  dp3 o4.z, cb12[9].xyzx, r1.yzwy
    o5.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyz, r1.yzw);                                             // 112  dp3 o5.z, cb12[10].xyzx, r1.yzwy
                                                                                          // 113  add r0.w, -cb12[36].x, cb2[4].w   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 114  mov r0.xyz, cb2[4].xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 115  dp4 o7.x, r0.xyzw, r2.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 116  add r0.w, -cb12[36].y, cb2[5].w   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 117  mov r0.xyz, cb2[5].xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 118  dp4 o7.y, r0.xyzw, r2.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 119  add r0.w, -cb12[36].z, cb2[6].w   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 120  mov r0.xyz, cb2[6].xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 121  dp4 o7.z, r0.xyzw, r2.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 122  dp4 o7.w, cb2[7].xyzw, r2.xyzw   [no consumer: omitted]
    return;                                                                               // 123  ret
}

    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.yy * tcs_TEXCOORD0[1].xy;                                        // 95  mul r1.xy, vDomain.yyyy, vicp[1][4].xyxx
    r1.xy = gl_TessCoord.xx * tcs_TEXCOORD0[0].xy + r1.xy;                                // 96  mad r1.xy, vDomain.xxxx, vicp[0][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx
    o1.xy = gl_TessCoord.zz * tcs_TEXCOORD0[2].xy + r1.xy;                                // 97  mad o1.xy, vDomain.zzzz, vicp[2][4].xyxx, r1.xyxx

    b1.z = (0.0 != tcs_pc_PSIZE0.y);                                                      // 101  ne r1.z, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), vpc0.y

        r1.z = gl_TessCoord.x * tcs_TEXCOORD7[0].z + r1.z;                                // 104  mad r1.z, vDomain.x, vicp[0][4].z, r1.z
        r1.y = gl_TessCoord.z * tcs_TEXCOORD7[2].z + r1.z;                                // 105  mad r1.y, vDomain.z, vicp[2][4].z, r1.z
        b1.z = (r1.y != 0.0);                                                             // 106  ne r1.z, r1.y, l(0.000000)

            r2.xyz = r0.xyz + -DismemberAdjustedHitLoc.xyz;                               // 108  add r2.xyz, r0.xyzx, -cb2[5].xyzx

            r1.zw = r1.zw * vec2(0.5, 0.5) + vec2(0.5, 0.5);                              // 114  mad r1.zw, r1.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.500000, 0.500000)
            r2.x = textureLod(t7, r1.zw, 0.0).x;                                          // 115  sample_l_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r2.x, r1.zwzz, t7.xyzw, s7, l(0.000000)

    o0.x = dot(cb12_viewproj[0].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 141  dp4 o0.x, cb12[8].xyzw, r0.xyzw

    o0.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                           // 144  dp4 o0.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    return;                                                                               // 145  ret
